article.headline: Scores from last Night: Faith Christian wins at Meridian HomeSchool, earns winning district mark
article.html:
Faith Christian HomeSchool Academy left Meridian with a 32–22 victory Saturday, October 17, and a winning district record. The Tornadoes from Madison won the boys varsity eight-man football matchup at Meridian HomeSchool, moving to 3–2 in district play after entering the night level in league wins and losses.

Road win separates the district records

The updated MaxPreps team pages list Faith Christian at 4–6 overall and Meridian HomeSchool at 3–6. Their district marks now stand at 3–2 and 3–4, respectively. Saturday’s result gave the visitors another league win while leaving the Flyers with more district losses than wins.

The road result also came against a team whose reported home record had been stronger than its overall mark. Meridian HomeSchool entered 3–1 at home, a point highlighted in our Saturday Games To Watch preview. Both programs came into the matchup with level district records: Faith Christian at 2–2 and the Flyers at 3–3.

A confirmed final, with scoring details still limited

The dated varsity game page confirms Faith Christian’s away conference win and the 32–22 final. Its quarter-by-quarter fields remain unreported, so the available box score does not establish how the lead or scoring developed.

This edition is a focused recap of one verified Saturday result. Swimming, cross-country and other unconfirmed outcomes are outside this selection; missing coverage does not mean those events were not held.
